Open-source licences

Ocadox is built with open-source software, and its image, video, speech, editing and music features download open engines and models. Thank you to everyone who made them. Their licences are below; they apply to those components, not to Ocadox itself, which is covered by the Terms.

Generated October 17, 2026: 998 packages.

Downloaded when you set up a feature

These are not part of the Ocadox download. Ocadox fetches them from their publishers when you turn the feature on. Language models come from Ollama, under each model's own licence, shown on ollama.com.
